## Belabra (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
 N Medium aberration  

**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +10  
 
  

**Defense**

 **AC** 15, touch 12, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +3 natural)  

**hp** 44 (4d8+8 plus 4)  

**Fort** +3; **Ref** +3; **Will** +5  
 
  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 5 ft., fly 20 ft. (poor)  

**Melee** slam +6 (2d4+2), tentacles +4 (grab) or bite +6 (2d4+3), tentacles +4 (grab)  

**Special Attacks** acidic blood, tentacle-barbs  
 
  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 14, **Dex** 15, **Con** 14, **Int** 7, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 11  

**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +6 (+10 grapple); **CMD** 18 (can’t be tripped)  

**Feats** Multiattack, Toughness  

**Skills** Fly -2, Perception +10, Stealth +9; **Racial Modifiers** +2 Perception  
 
  

**Special Abilities**

 **Acidic Blood (Ex)** Each time a belabra is hit with a slashing or piercing weapon, all creatures within a 10-ft. radius must succeed on a DC 14 Reflex save or be sprayed by the creature’s acidic blood. The save DC is Constitution-based.
